annotation.bound_parties_text: The law binds any Person (natural or legal) piloting, using, designing, manufacturing, importing, selling, owning or operating Unmanned Aircraft, including Operators, Pilots, Controllers, Crew Members, Owners, and Government Entities.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: No Person may pilot or use Unmanned Aircraft; conduct Operations or Related Activities; or construct any Infrastructure or Unmanned Aircraft Airport in the Emirate, without first obtaining the relevant Permit from the DCAA.
annotation.dates_quote: This Law will be published in the Official Gazette and will come into force on the day on which it is published. ... Issued in Dubai on 25 June 2020
annotation.robot_provision_quote: This Law will be cited as "Law No. (4) of 2020 Regulating Unmanned Aircraft in the Emirate of Dubai".
